## U.S. GoldMining Appoints John DeLucchi to Its Board of Directors to Support Strategic Growth and Advancement of the Whistler Gold-Copper Project, Alaska


**Share:**


**Anchorage, Alaska – November 3, 2026 –** U.S. GoldMining Inc. (NASDAQ: USGO) ("U.S. GoldMining" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) has appointed John DeLucchi as a director of the Company effective as of November 2, 2026. Mr. DeLucchi has also been appointed Chair of the Audit Committee of the Board.


**Highlights of the Appointment**


- **Distinguished Executive & Governance** **Track Record:** Mr. DeLucchi brings over 35 years of international senior leadership experience across professional services, capital markets, and corporate governance.
- **Financial Leadership** : Over a 35-year tenure at PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), including 21 years as Partner, he served as the British Columbia Region Managing Partner (2009-2017) and on the Board of Directors of PwC Canada (2018-2020).
- **Corporate & Operational Acumen** : As the former Chief Executive Officer of Madison Venture Corporation (Madison Group), he provided deep expertise and operating experience across multiple sectors as well as with capital allocation and strategic partnerships.
- **Board and Governance Expertise:** Skilled board member with Chair of the board of directors, finance, audit and investment committee leadership roles.


**Alastair Still, Chairperson of the Board, commented:** “We are delighted to welcome John to our Board of Directors and as our new Audit Committee Chair. As we systematically seek to unlock the potential of our Whistler Gold-Copper Project, having a director of John’s caliber strengthens our financial oversight, governance framework, and long-term execution capabilities. His extensive past leadership at PwC advising multinational public issuers, combined with his recent executive tenure at the Madison Group, aligns directly with our disciplined, catalyst-driven development mandate.”


**John DeLucchi, Director and Chair of Audit Committee, added** : “As an advanced PEA-stage project, we believe Whistler represents a tier-one development opportunity in a secure jurisdiction. We believe, with significant regional infrastructure momentum, such as the state-led West Susitna Access Road, the Company is well positioned to generate sustained stakeholder value. I look forward to collaborating with the management team and the Board to advance growth opportunities at our gold-copper core asset.”


**About John DeLucchi**


Until October 2026, Mr. DeLucchi was the Chief Executive Officer of the Madison Group, an enterprise with diversified real estate, operating, and investment assets operating in Canada and the U.S. Prior to joining the Madison Group in 2020, Mr. DeLucchi spent over 35 years with PwC, including 21 years as Partner. During his tenure at PwC, he served as the Managing Partner for the British Columbia Region from 2009 to 2017 and was elected to the National Board of Directors of PwC Canada from 2018 to 2020. Over his career, he has worked with major public and private multinational companies and has experience with initial public offerings and complex financings, risk management, governance, and securities regulatory compliance.


Mr. DeLucchi is a Fellow Chartered Professional Accountant (FCPA, FCA). In addition to his executive mandates, he serves as a director of Madison Pacific Properties Inc. and has previously served on numerous community and public policy boards, including Canuck Place Children’s Hospice, Covenant House Vancouver, and the Business Council of British Columbia.


**About U.S. GoldMining Inc.**


U.S. GoldMining Inc. is an exploration and development company focused on advancing the 100% owned Whistler Gold-Copper Project, located 105 miles (170 kilometers) northwest of Anchorage, Alaska, U.S.A. The Whistler Project consists of several gold-copper porphyry deposits and exploration targets within a large regional land package entirely on State of Alaska mining claims totaling approximately 53,700 acres (217.5 square kilometers).
